title: Buzz Aldrin's Apollo 11 sighting retold on Larry King Live
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Buzz Aldrin's Apollo 11 sighting retold on Larry King Live, about 1969 at Apollo 11; Larry King Live studio, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know, like with the case of Buzz Aldrin, I was on Larry King Live once with Buzz Aldrin and a couple of the UFO people.

related.note: The same Larry King Live appearance with Buzz Aldrin and UFO people that James Fox describes. Shermer's account seems to present Aldrin's explanation as honest, while Fox says Aldrin lied because someone had got to him.

plain: A well-known skeptic and writer, Michael Shermer, says he once appeared on Larry King Live, a US television talk show, alongside Buzz Aldrin, the astronaut who flew to the moon on Apollo 11 in 1969, and a couple of UFO researchers. On the show, Shermer says, they talked about something Aldrin saw during the Apollo 11 flight, a sighting often told as a possible UFO. Shermer brings it up as an example of how such stories get told and retold.
